headline: No school's already-approved-CPT posture changed and tripwires are unchanged. The only move: Berea College resolved from unresolved to clear after its official course catalog turned out to carry the CPT policy text — standard eligibility language only, no reference to the August guidance. Haverford and Bucknell stay parked on durable blocks (a 403 and a login-walled portal redirect).

tripwires.name: DHS SEVIS Help Hub CPT page
tripwires.detail: Direct fetch succeeded again 25 Sept 08:16 HKT. Page still 'Last Updated: August 24, 2026'; same BCM 2608-01/2608-02 references and explicit confirmation DSOs can only shorten (not retroactively cancel) CPT after its start date. Guidance page: still says SEVP plans to release draft guidance, no date. No change detected.

tripwires.name: Tufts I-Center CPT page
tripwires.detail: Direct fetch succeeded again 25 Sept 08:16 HKT — page still carries the line 'due to recent updates to guidelines, the I-Center is unable to process CPT requests for non-required internships at this time'; still nothing either way about students who already hold CPT authorisation. No change detected.

tripwires.name: Federal Register rulemaking on CPT
tripwires.detail: Checked 25 Sept 08:16 HKT — no NPRM published, underlying CPT regulation (8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)) not amended. DHS's Unified Agenda still lists the 'Practical Training' rule (OPT/STEM OPT/CPT) targeting a proposed rule in February 2027 — an agenda entry, not published text. CPT remains guidance (12/24 Aug broadcast messages), not a rule.

tripwires.name: Retroactive cancellation spreading
tripwires.detail: Checked 25 Sept 08:16 HKT via newspaper, .edu and 1point3acres sweeps (zhihu not due this run). Still only Davidson (15 Aug), MIT and Skidmore interrupt already-granted CPT. No new reports. Watching closely.
